name: Palworld Crafting
description: Palworld-style survival economy for Gen 1: a placeable SECRET BASE where your POKeMON work jobs by type, craft queues, breeding with egg moves, an essence CONDENSER star system, hourly overworld bosses with summonable empowered forms, and a HARD difficulty built around breeding. Balls are crafted from apricorns, stones are crafted from ore, and every gym badge unlocks a blueprint.
